business_problem: It is time-consuming, error-prone, and cost-prohibitive for Ontada to generate key insights using manual processes to analyze 150 million unstructured oncology documents.
solution_summary: Ontada modernized its analytics estate on Azure OpenAI Service Batch API, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. It also connects with surrounding systems such as iKnowMed, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Knowing each data point can make a life-changing difference for cancer patients. The architecture emphasizes managed services, reusable integrations, and governed data handling so the organization can scale adoption without rebuilding the solution for each new team or use case.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service Batch API
solution_components.role: Processes large document batches asynchronously to extract structured entities at scale.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts text, layout, and document fields before downstream AI or analytics processing.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt AI capabilities such as language, speech, or vision services within the application flow.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Document Intelligence, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
